title: Mesoporous zirconium based metal–organic frameworks, a topological review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30654-30682
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04309C, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pouya Khattami Kermanshahi, Pooria Refah, Kamran Akhbari
Zirconium-carboxylate MOFs show high stability, diverse porous structures, and broad applications. This review examines 10 reported topologies over the past decade, highlighting their unique properties and influence on MOF applications.
